author: claude
summary: Task 009 (voice-card-consolidation, P8): non-destructive retakes, capture-time quality feedback, client-side WAV transcode, and finalize->upload for VoiceLab's Record mode. Adds qualityCheck.ts (duration floor/clipping/silence verdict), transcodeToWav.ts (WebM/Opus -> WAV via OfflineAudioContext decode + hand-rolled PCM16 WAV encoder), TakeManager.tsx (candidate-take list: Keep appends, Retake never discards a prior take, explicit per-take Discard), and wires a real Keep/Retake UI into RecordControls.tsx (task 008 had accepted but not used the onKeep/onRetake props). Also adds a narrow, pre-approved server-side collision guard at voices_actions.py's upload endpoint.

files.change: New. checkSampleQuality(audioBuffer) returns { ok, durationSeconds, hasClipping, isSilent, message? }: duration floor (1s), peak-amplitude clipping check (>=0.98 full scale), RMS-based silence check (<0.02 RMS).

New. Decodes a captured Blob via OfflineAudioContext.decodeAudioData, then hand-rolls a 44-byte RIFF/WAVE header + interleaved 16-bit PCM data (no new dependency; wavesurfer.js is playback-only, not an encoder).

New. Wraps RecordControls; onKeep appends a take (never replaces in place), onRetake is a no-op at this layer (RecordControls already reset itself, no prior take touched), per-take Discard button removes only that take. Enter (keep)/R (retake) keyboard shortcuts wired at the container level, deferring to the actual Keep/Retake buttons so the quality gate is respected. Finalize transcodes every kept take to WAV and assigns each a unique filename (timestamp + index + random suffix) before calling the existing uploadFiles sink unchanged.

Adds the captured-state UI on top of task 008's record/stop primitive: decodes the captured blob and runs checkSampleQuality, shows the verdict (pass/fail + reason), a 'Play back' control, and the Keep/Retake button group that now actually calls onKeep(blob)/onRetake() (previously accepted-but-unused props) then rec.reset(). Implements this task's two owned INV-REC-4 focus transitions: stopped->playback (focus moves to the Play back button on activation) and playback->keep/retake (focus lands on the Keep button on audio onEnded/onPause).
Swaps the bare <RecordControls /> for <TakeManager onFinalize={uploadFiles} />, wiring the existing useVariantActions uploadFiles sink (unchanged) as the finalize callback.

Upload endpoint (:271-306): adds a narrow existence-check collision guard immediately before the write -- on collision, auto-suffixes the target filename (_1, _2, ...) rather than rejecting, so a retry-free upload flow keeps working. This is the pre-approved, narrow exception to the 'no backend changes' rule (client-side unique naming alone isn't sufficient at the persistence layer).

Enter keeps the current take only; flagged here rather than inventing new cue-card sequencing.
